    """
    A 4D benchmark function combining a skewed quadratic bowl with a shifted cosine wave and linear terms for ELA feature blending.
    """
    x = np.asarray(x)
    if x.shape != (4,):
        raise ValueError(f"Expected input of shape (4,), got {x.shape}")

    # Skewed quadratic bowl
    quadratic_term = np.sum((x - 0.5)**2)  # Shifted quadratic, to get nonzero skewness
    skew_factor = 0.353  # Target skewness
    skewed_quadratic = quadratic_term + skew_factor * np.sum((x - 0.5)**3) # Skew the bowl

    # Cosine wave
    cosine_frequency = 1.0  # Frequency of oscillations
    cosine_amplitude = 0.1  # Adjust amplitude of cosine to change fitness std
    cosine_phase = np.pi/4  # Introducing shift

    cosine_term = cosine_amplitude * np.cos(cosine_frequency * np.sum(x) + cosine_phase)  # Creating cosine waves

    # Linear Interaction Terms for ELA
    linear_weights = np.array([0.1, -0.2, 0.05, 0.15])
    linear_interaction = np.sum(linear_weights * x)

    return skewed_quadratic + cosine_term + linear_interaction
